request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Change only two things. The wood of the cart's planks and wheels becomes dark chocolate brown with mid-brown highlights on the plank edges; clearly dark brown, not black, not red. The little goblin in the cart gets a lighter olive green face, ears and hands with big cream eyes and a mid-brown leather cap. Keep everything else the same: the five paper rockets, their colours, stars and cream cones, sticks, rope, fuse spark, the cart and wheel shapes, black outline and art style.
